faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MMMUT Junior Research Assistant (JRA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the MMMUT Junior Research Assistant (JRA) recruitment is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post is 28 years as of 1st April 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRA post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering or an equivalent degree with First Class (at least 75% marks average).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MMMUT JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MMMUT JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position is scheduled to be held on 1st October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology located?
faq.answer: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 273010.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, which is www.mmmut.ac.in.
